atoms.b: Every morning, Cherie gets into her parents’ car and fastens her seatbelt because it’s the ((rule ++law)).
Her dad makes sure to drive under the speed limit, so he doesn’t break the ((rules ++law)) by speeding.
Once she’s in school, Cherie sees that one of her classmates is breaking her teacher’s ((++rules laws)) by wearing a hat in class.
After school, she heads to the playground with her friends. She makes sure to be home before it’s dark since this is one of her mum’s ((++rules laws)).
On her way home, she makes sure to put her rubbish in the bin because it’s against the ((rule ++law)) to litter.
Cherie must go to bed by 8 pm on a school night. This is one of her family’s ((++rules laws)).
